item_short_desc: The ABC Adjustable Guide Harness is a versatile mountaineering and rappelling essential that you can count on.
description: The ABC Adjustable Guide Harness is a versatile mountaineering and rappelling essential that you can count on. This one-size-fits-most mountaineering harness is fully adjustable and features two high-quality aluminum aircraft buckles. The rappelling harness is constructed with a lightweight yet durable material composition with powerful 4000 LB test two-inch webbing.
